shared_elements: elongated horizontal linear motif spanning the surface
schematic profile figure with projecting short appendages (crew strokes / animal legs)
stacked/overlapping horizontal elements on an irregular rock face
justification: Both surfaces carry highly schematic, strongly horizontal linear motifs with short perpendicular projections (crew strokes on the hulls in A, limbs on the creature in B) set against a bare rock ground, and both stack a long curving line beneath the main figure. But the subjects are quite different: A depicts repeated manned boats with upturned prows, an entirely inanimate vehicle motif, while B depicts a single quadruped animal in profile above an arc-and-band element, with no shared specific iconography.
